dedupe_keys.name: namibian agronomic board grain and horticulture statistics white maize wheat and pearl millet production imports and consumption grain floor prices fresh produce and grape exports

description: The Namibian Agronomic Board regulates the country's controlled grain and fresh produce markets, and its website publishes the statistics behind that work. For grain, downloadable spreadsheets give white maize, wheat and pearl millet by marketing year: area planted, marketed domestic production, the average producer price, imports, exports of processed products and total consumption, plus a file of domestic floor prices from 2010 to 2022. The page headlines 98,824 tonnes of white maize and 24,696 tonnes of wheat marketed in 2022/2023. For horticulture, web tables show grape export tonnage and value from 2010/11 to 2018/19 and the ten largest fresh produce lines by local purchase and by import in 2016/17, showing how much of the country's potatoes, apples and onions came from abroad. The files are free to download as Excel workbooks. Caveats: several series stop years ago, horticulture figures are web tables, not files, and no licence is stated. Coverage is national. Simulation uses: import dependence and consumption baselines for Namibian staple food supply under drought and border disruption scenarios. Related records: the WFP global food prices database (data-wfp-global-food-prices) complements the board's producer prices with retail market prices.
